test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. I had my own crib in the bedroom next to our parent’s room.

Q. Annie awoke hungry at 2:30 a.m. each morning.

R. When Annie would cry out, I would climb out of my crib and come running into our parent’s room to check on her.

S. For the first few months, Annie slept in a crib by our parents’ bed.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "SPQR." 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence S is the first sentence as it begins with the phrase 'For the first few months'. This sentence establishes the setting of the story, indicating where Annie slept during the initial period i.e., in a crib by the parents’ bed. This sets the context for the rest of the paragraph.
 
• Sentence P is the second sentence as it begins with the noun 'I' and explains that the speaker had her/his own crib in the bedroom next to their parents' room. This further develops the setting and explains where the speaker slept in relation to Annie. Thus, it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence Q is the third sentence as it begins with the noun 'Annie' and introduces a new idea - that Annie would wake up hungry at 2:30 a.m. each morning. This creates a sense of urgency and sets up the problem that the speaker needs to solve.
 
• Sentence R is the last sentence which explains how the speaker responded to Annie's cries by climbing out of their own crib and running into their parents' room to check on her. This provides a resolution to the problem set up in the previous sentence and shows how the speaker took care of their younger sibling. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__ 

**S.** For the first few months, Annie slept in a crib by our parents’ bed.

**P.** I had my own crib in the bedroom next to our parent’s room.

**Q.** Annie awoke hungry at 2:30 a.m. each morning.

**R.** When Annie would cry out, I would climb out of my crib and come running into our parent’s room to check on her.
